title: Correct refractive index
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be n = √2 (or approximately 1.414).

title: Correct speed in liquid
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be v = c/√2 (or approximately 0.707c).

title: Identifies critical angle condition
description: Important: The solution must apply the condition for total internal reflection, relating the incident angle at the liquid-air interface to the critical angle.

title: Relates angle to refractive index
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the relationship n = 1 / sin(C), where C is the identified critical angle.

title: Applies speed-index relationship
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the relationship v = c / n to find the speed in the liquid.

title: Interprets geometry of beam
description: Optional: The solution may correctly interpret the 45° angle given in the problem as the critical angle at the interface.

title: Confuses incident and critical angle
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses the 45° angle as the angle of incidence in Snell's law instead of the critical angle.

title: Misapplies speed formula
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly writes v = n * c instead of v = c / n.
